title: The Script Detective
short_description: Understand the intent of an automation script.
summary: Read a script and identify its primary output based on logic.
description: An internal script named `legacy_processor.py` is used to calculate bulk discounts. Read the code and determine what it outputs for a transaction of $500 with a 'premium' status. You must create a `check_result.txt` file in the workspace containing only the numeric discount value found by tracing the code.
lore: The Old Architect left behind scrolls of logic. We need a Detective to decypher their meaning before we run them on the main core.

title: Data Flow Analysis
short_description: Follow a variable through multiple transformations.
summary: Trace how an initial value is modified by several helper functions.
description: The `data_pipeline.py` script applies three transformations to an input string. Trace the flow and determine the final string value if the input is 'foundry-v1'. Save the resulting string in `final_identity.txt`.
lore: Data flows through the Foundry like steam through pipes. One wrong valve and the whole system loses pressure. Map the flow.

title: Dependency Tracker
short_description: Trace logic across multiple imported modules.
summary: Identify where a specific constant is defined in a multi-file script.
description: The `main_runner.py` script imports from `utils/logic.py` and `config/settings.py`. One of these files defines the `CORE_PROTOCOL_VERSION`. Find the value of this constant and save it in `protocol_version.txt`.
lore: The Foundry is built on layers. You can't just look at the top; you must follow the linkages down into the deep modules.

title: Side Effect Auditor
short_description: Identify which files a script modifies.
summary: Identify the external impact of a script beyond its return value.
description: Examine `sync_tool.py`. Determine which file it writes to when an error occurs. Save the filename in `side_effect.txt`.
lore: Every action has a reaction. A script might return 'Success' but leave a trail of logs or temp files behind. Be the Auditor.

title: Environment Weaver
summary: Determine if a script uses a hardcoded default or an environment variable.
description: The `database_connector.py` looks for `DB_PORT`. Trace the logic to see what port it uses if `DB_PORT` is NOT set. Save the default port number in `default_port.txt`.
lore: Scripts adapt to their surroundings. But sometimes they cling to old habits. Find their default nature.

title: The First Anomaly
short_description: Find and fix a logical flaw in a data script.
summary: Locate a bug where a list is being mutated while iterating.
description: The `cleanup_tool.py` script is supposed to remove stale entries from a list, but it skips every other entry. Find the bug and fix it. The script must correctly print all remaining valid entries.
lore: The cleanup droids are leaving half the scrap behind. Trace their logic and find why their sensors are failing to see the full list.
